description: Curated, version-controlled list of industry-frontier and offline-first tools/topics this knowledge base should track. scripts/coverage_gap_scan.py diffs this against data/all_tools.json and surfaces entries that lack a canonical page. This file IS the 'where the industry is going' signal, kept offline and in-repo so the automation keeps evolving the repo even with no network access. Add entries as the landscape shifts; the scanner stops flagging an entry automatically once it is catalogued. Keep aliases populated to avoid false gaps from naming variations.

entries.name: GPT4All
entries.why: Popular fully-offline desktop LLM runner with a local document-chat (LocalDocs) feature; a natural privacy-first alternative to cloud chat for the home lab.

entries.name: Llamafile
entries.why: Ships an entire model + runtime as one cross-platform executable — the simplest way to run an LLM air-gapped with zero install.

entries.name: faster-whisper
entries.why: CTranslate2 reimplementation of Whisper that is 4x faster and lighter; the default for offline transcription pipelines feeding Paperless/Obsidian.

entries.name: PrivateGPT
entries.why: Self-hosted, fully-local RAG over private documents; directly aligned with the repo's privacy-first home-lab thesis.

entries.name: text-generation-webui
entries.why: Mature local web UI supporting many backends (llama.cpp, ExLlama, Transformers); a power-user alternative to Open WebUI for self-hosting.

entries.name: Docling
entries.why: Fast local document-to-structured-text parser (PDF, DOCX, tables) that runs offline; strong feeder for local RAG and Paperless ingestion.

entries.name: Model Context Protocol Servers
entries.why: The MCP server ecosystem is the fastest-moving interop layer for agent tooling; a canonical index of self-hostable MCP servers keeps the stack current.

entries.name: Promptfoo
entries.why: Local-first prompt/LLM eval and red-teaming harness; lets the home lab benchmark local models offline without a SaaS account.

entries.name: DSPy
entries.why: Programmatic prompt/program optimization framework gaining rapid adoption; works against local models, fitting the offline thesis.

entries.name: Open Interpreter
entries.why: Local code-executing agent that can drive a machine with local models; relevant to home-automation agent patterns.

entries.name: Qdrant
entries.why: De-facto self-hosted vector database for local RAG. The catalog only has heavyweight Milvus/Weaviate and cloud-only Pinecone — the lightweight local vector layer that makes offline RAG work is undocumented.

entries.name: Chroma
entries.why: Lightweight embedded vector DB, the default for quick local RAG prototypes; pairs with local embeddings to deliver the repo's offline-RAG thesis.

entries.name: LanceDB
entries.why: Embedded, file-based, zero-server vector store ideal for air-gapped single-box home labs.

entries.name: Local embedding models
entries.why: The embedding side of offline RAG (nomic-embed, bge, gte). Nothing in the catalog documents running embeddings locally, leaving the RAG pattern pages without an offline backend.

entries.name: Llama (model family)
entries.why: The most-referenced missing page: ~15 inbound 'Related tools' links point to a Llama model-family page that does not exist, despite 10+ Llama-adjacent runtime pages.

entries.name: Gemma (model family)
entries.why: Google's open local model family, commonly run via Ollama/llama.cpp; referenced by several docs with no canonical page.

entries.name: Inspect AI
entries.why: Open eval framework (UK AISI) gaining adoption; can evaluate local models offline. ~5 inbound links expect a page.

entries.name: llama-swap
entries.why: Hot-swaps local GGUF models behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint — key for running many local models on constrained home-lab hardware.

entries.name: Ramalama
entries.why: Container-native (Podman/OCI) local model runner; emerging reproducible-serving alternative to Ollama for air-gapped boxes.
